description: This file defines the UpCastRule object in Spark SQL, which determines whether certain data types can be safely upcasted without data loss or runtime errors. It includes logic for numeric, string, date/time, array, map, struct, and user-defined types.

methods.name: canUpCast
methods.description: Determines if the 'from' data type can be safely upcasted to the 'to' data type without data loss or runtime failure.

methods.name: legalNumericPrecedence
methods.description: Checks if the numeric type 'from' has precedence lower than 'to' in the numeric hierarchy.

methods.name: resolvableNullability
methods.description: Checks if nullability of 'from' and 'to' types are compatible for upcasting.
